uneven-line.title: Holes & Stars — Spread four openings evenly or gather them into pairs
notes: Four point openings span one and a half mask units, with equal half-unit gaps. Illumination and the inspected spot stay put.
The same outer openings frame a close inner pair. The middle gap is 0.2 mask units; this is not a continuous slit.
Four openings gather into two outer pairs, with within-pair gaps of 0.15 mask units and a central gap of 1.2.
uneven-line.facts: Source order exactly supplied, all within[-1,1], no duplicates. All rows centroid0/bounds[-.75,.75]; spacings .5/.5/.5, .65/.2/.65, .15/1.2/.15. Gaps are toy mask units, not physical mm.

triangle-shift.title: Holes & Stars — Move an entire three-opening triangle without changing its shape
notes: Three ideal point openings make the centered triangle. Using changes the mask, not the selected illumination or spot.
Every source moves up by 0.2 mask units. Relative gaps are unchanged; a common translation changes shared phase, not ideal point-array brightness.
Every source moves right by 0.2 mask units. Relative gaps are unchanged. This is a common move of the array, not of the inspected sky spot.
triangle-shift.facts: Rows are base triangle plus(0,0), (0,.2), (.2,0). Equal source amplitudes/phase array factor acquires common exp(i*2*pi*(dx*u+dy*v)); |sum|² unchanged under translation. Keep arbitrary shipped source strength/phase settings; common translation still factors. Opening envelope not changed.

paired-columns.title: Holes & Stars — Tilt three horizontal pairs without moving their centers
notes: Three pair centers lie on the vertical axis. Each horizontal pair has a 0.4-mask-unit gap.
Each pair turns diagonally around its own center. The 0.24 by 0.32 displacement still has length 0.4 mask units.
Each pair turns upright around its own center. Pair gaps remain 0.4; the three centers stay at -0.6, 0 and 0.6.
paired-columns.facts: Each pair center (0,-.6),(0,0),(0,.6); displacement vector(.4,0),(.24,.32),(0,.4), lengths .4 since .24²+.32²=.16. Exact coordinates supplied avoid trig mismatch. Six unique sources per row.
